title: rotate_secret_ref
description: Updates a secret reference (e.g. in a Kubernetes Secret, ExternalSecret, or environment config) to point to a new secret version or ARN.

secret_name.description: The name of the secret whose reference should be rotated (e.g. 'db-password', 'api-key-stripe').

new_ref.description: The new secret reference value, such as a Secrets Manager ARN, a Vault path, or a new secret version identifier.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace in which the secret lives. Defaults to 'default' if omitted and a namespace is required.
